shape.appetite: One theme contract, three themes (Compact, Newsprint, Report), headline in shared chrome, themed axes on seven axisPlan families, four color-reach fixes. No theme editor.
shape.problem: Charts cannot follow a chosen theme or carry an authored headline; titles are one truncated toolbar line and several charts bypass shared palettes.

recommended_shape.summary: Workspace theme picker in a new Theme tab; themes are named text-role, surface, and palette tokens resolved host → analysis → chart; one chart header restyled by the theme (no separate toolbar strip), with hover actions floating over the title corner and status on the subtitle line; measured headline and axis text drive geometry; overrides listed with reset.
recommended_shape.source_of_truth: Optional theme on SavedDataStructure (absent = Compact); optional subtitle, note, and style overrides on chart settings; host tokens via CSS custom properties on the workspace root.
